title: LUMEN & SALT
oneLine: Pilot a tethered bathyscaphe down the Halcyon Trench: grapple drifting wrecks, cut the salvage free, mind the weight of it, and surface before the air runs out.
goal: Surface with $1,800 banked to close the salvage contract while three yard contracts run alongside it. Below 75 m the Black Shelf pays more and costs more; below 150 m the Brine Hollow pays most and hunts you with a glassmaw.
loseCondition: Run ends when hull integrity or oxygen reaches zero. Both are shown in the HUD, and both are finite.
winCondition: Bank $1,800 across any number of dives and the contract-complete screen appears.

controls.A / D or Left / Right: lateral thrust; the bathyscaphe accelerates and coasts, no instant snap
controls.W / S or Up / Down: vent (rise) or flood (sink) ballast; venting all the way is the fast ascent
controls.hold left mouse button: fire the grapple toward the pointer; keep holding to stay tethered, release to let go
controls.hold E: cut the nearest salvage piece free while tethered to its wreck
controls.F: switch the lamp; the cone lights the wreck and the salvage, and wakes the lures
controls.Q: fire a sonar ping: reveal and drowse everything nearby (9 s cooldown)

systems.oxygen: The clock of every dive. Drain is 0.62/s plus 0.0125/s per metre of depth, so the deep tiers cost real air. Surfacing refills the tank.
systems.ballast: Ballast runs 0..1 with 0.5 neutral. Buoyancy pushes up when vented and down when flooded, so the ascent speed is the ballast setting, not a fixed rate.
systems.tether: The hook flies at 1550 px/s up to 560 px. Once attached, a spring (stiffness 10.5) pulls the diver toward the anchor, the wreck feels 18% of that pull, and a tether stretched 250 px past its rest length snaps.
systems.salvage: Eight classes, each with its own mass, value and cut time: copper coil (36/1.0 t/1.35 s), amber glass (66/1.4/1.2), silver ingot (110/2.2/1.6), trench relic (210/2.8/1.9), brine pearl (92/0.7/0.85), lumen bloom (128/0.9/1.05), obsidian shard (165/3.2/2.45) and drowned bell (330/4.6/3.1). The cut time lives on the piece, so a bell is a commitment: it takes the longest to free and drags the ascent down hardest.
systems.wrecks: Each wreck holds 2-4 pieces and 2+tier integrity. Every cut frees a piece and costs integrity; at zero the hull buckles and collapses after 2.1 s, damaging anything inside 190 px and destroying the pieces still attached.
systems.lures: Bioluminescent drifters on a deterministic patrol. The lamp wakes one within 380 px and it chases at 122 px/s; with the lamp off it forgets the diver in 2.4 s.
systems.currents: Bands every 620 px push the diver and nudge the wrecks, drawn as streaks so they can be read before entering.
systems.refits: Thirteen refits, three offered after each surfacing. The trades: Light servo (+18% thrust, +12% air), Deep hull (+40 hull, -25 s air), Sweep lens (+30% cut range and +15% speed, lures notice +30% further), Sonar array (wider ping, shorter cooldown), Air cache (a spare +18 s pod beside the first wreck each dive) and Slack rope (the tether never snaps and reaches 15% further, but pulls 25% weaker).
systems.score: Banked dollars are the score. The best haul is kept in localStorage and shown on the title and end screens.
systems.environmentBands: Three depth bands, each with its own palette, hazard mix, wreck density, current strength and salvage table. UPPER TRENCH (0-75 m): teal water, lures only, tier-1 table. BLACK SHELF (75-150 m): violet, currents x1.55, wrecks 42% denser, vents and wells, salvage x1.34, table of glass/ingot/relic plus pearls and obsidian. BRINE HOLLOW (150 m+): rust-amber, currents x1.9, wrecks 75% denser, vents, wells and a roaming glassmaw, salvage x1.8, table of lumen bloom, obsidian and drowned bell. Crossing a band raises a short breathing vignette with the band's name.
systems.siltVents: Telegraphed columns on an 8 s cycle: 4.8 s idle, 1.4 s warning (the mouth turns amber and silt rises), 1.8 s blast (an upward plume 220 px tall and 96 px wide). Inside the plume the diver takes 10 damage and is pushed up 190 px/s. No random damage: the warning is the window to cross or steer round.
systems.pressureWells: A 9 s cycle: 3.5 s rest, 1.5 s warning (rings contract), 4 s pull. Inside the 180 px radius the well adds a pull toward its core, strongest at the centre; a diver inside the 29 px core takes 14 damage. The outer ring is always escapable with thrust, so it is a positioning hazard, not a coin flip.
systems.combo: Each piece cut inside a 7.5 s window raises the multiplier by 0.25, to x2.5. The window decays in real time, so a combo is only worth chasing while the wreck is safe; the HUD shows the multiplier and the time left.
systems.feel: Held input is sampled every frame; a tap of E or the mouse is buffered for 130 ms so a press shorter than a fixed step is never lost. A 1.15 s dive-start sequence holds the diver at the hatch (the run clock does not advance) with the tank and hull read out. Hits trigger a 70 ms hit-stop, a hull flash and shake.
systems.elite: The glassmaw: one roaming elite in the Brine Hollow. It prowls a slow home circuit, then locks a lane toward the diver and telegraphs for 1.25 s with a dashed danger lane and a filling ring; the lane is fixed at lock time, so stepping out of it is the counter. It charges at 520 px/s for 0.62 s (22 damage and a knockback), then recovers for 1.9 s where it cannot hurt anyone. A sonar ping drowses it.
systems.sonar: Q fires a sonar ping: 620 px radius, 2.6 s active, 9 s cooldown. While it rings it reveals wrecks (chevrons), lures (amber dots) and glassmaws (red dots), and drowses every lure and elite inside the radius, which is the escape from a wreck full of lures. The sonar-array refit widens it 45% and cuts the cooldown 28%.
systems.ascentPressure: Venting ballast hard is the fast way up and the way to a bend. Above 165 px/s ascent a bend builds (0.9/s scaled by overspeed); under it the body recovers at 0.55/s. Above 0.55 bend the hull takes continuous damage. The HUD shows the ascent rate, the safe marker and SAFE / FAST ASCENT / BEND, so the trade between speed and hull is always visible.
systems.contracts: Three yard contracts are rolled from the run seed out of seven kinds (bank a haul, cut pieces free, reach the depth, make dives, land a tonnage, raise a drowned bell, hold a combo), each with their own goal and cash reward. Progress is read live off the world, the HUD tracks all three, and the reward is paid once the moment the goal is met. The refit screen's last-dive panel shows what the dive earned, its tonnage, pieces lost to collapsing hulls and contract money paid.
systems.briefing: A first-dive briefing screen states the loop, the oxygen clock, the ascent rule (safe rate and the bend), what the deeper bands cost, and the contract target, then hands over to the loadout.
systems.difficultyRamp: Dive index drives the ramp: FIRST WATER (dives 1-2) spawns hazards at 40%, burns 68% of the air and spawns no elites; WORKING DIVE (3-4) is near baseline; DEEP CONTRACT (5+) runs hazards at 115%, air at 112% and elites at 140%. The loadout screen names the current step.
systems.loadout: Before every dive the diver fits two of three tools, and each changes play rather than a stat: Sonar set (Q pings), Power cutter (+40% cut speed and +10% range) and Ballast assist (+50% pump, safe ascent rate +25%). Fitting a third drops the oldest; the loadout screen shows the ramp and the open contracts.
systems.chorus: The chorus: a bell-singer that holds station in the Brine Hollow. It swells for 1.3 s (rings contract, the tell), then rings an expanding damaging band for 1.15 s out to 300 px; the eye (inside 26 px) and the water outside the band are safe. Then it rests 2.2 s. A sonar ping keeps it from singing.
systems.feedback: Every cut throws a rising +$value floater and a x-combo floater, sparks and a hull flash; hits freeze the frame for 70 ms and shake; the right edge carries a depth gauge with each band's accent colour, 30 m ticks and the diver's marker.

loop: Title screen: goal, controls, best haul.
Briefing on the first dive, then the loadout: fit two of three tools, then launch.

Dive: descend, read the band (the Black Shelf is richer and rougher), grapple a wreck, cut salvage free, hold the combo, dodge lures, read vents and wells, manage ballast and air, decide when to surface.

Dive: descend through three bands, read the hazard mix, grapple a wreck, cut salvage free (each class has its own cut time), hold the combo, ping the sonar, dodge lures, vents, wells and the glassmaw, keep the ascent safe on the way up.
Refit screen: one of three upgrades, then the next, deeper dive.
Contract complete at $1,800, or a run over screen on hull breach or an empty tank; SPACE restarts instantly.

performance.step: fixed 1/60 s; rendering is separate and reads the state
performance.pools: particles are fixed-size pools, no per-frame allocation of objects in the hot loop
performance.hazards: vents and wells are stepped in the fixed step; each is O(1) per instance and capped by spawn density

originality: All names, art, sound and systems are written for this entry: no engine, no library, no sampled audio or borrowed art.

testing.logic: node test/logic.test.mjs — headless fixed-step tests over oxygen, tether, grapple, cutting, weight, hazards, ascent, score, refits and restart
testing.browser: python3 test/browser_test.py — Playwright/Firefox under Xvfb against a local static server: start, move, grapple, cut, take damage, surface, refit, restart, menus, zero page errors
testing.capture: python3 tools/capture.py — the four screenshots, from the same static server
testing.tuning: node tools/autoplay.mjs 16 — a naive bot plays 16 seeds; the pass keeps it beatable but not free

hud.principle: Sized for the judge contact sheet: the cover is fitted to 768 px wide, a 0.6 scale of the 1280x720 canvas, so the HUD is set at 17-52 px in canvas space and carries only what a diver needs at a glance.

zones.top-left: OXYGEN and HULL: label 19 px, value 26-40 px, meter beneath
zones.top-centre: DEPTH 52 px, run clock 26 px, current band 17 px
zones.top-right: HAUL 40 px, banked 22 px, cargo 17 px, contract meter plus total 17 px, combo 28 px
zones.bottom-left: LAMP state and SONAR state, 18 px
zones.bottom-right: one threat line: tether tension with cut progress, else bend warning, else ascent rate
